reason: The README describes a general-purpose agent Skill that discovers local Skills, decomposes complex tasks, orchestrates multi-step workflows, and verifies resulting deliverables.

summaries.zh: 一个用于发现和调度本地 Skills、分解复杂任务、编排执行流程并检查交付结果的智能体工作流插件。
summaries.en: An agent workflow plugin that discovers and routes local Skills, decomposes complex tasks, orchestrates execution, and checks delivered results.

capabilities: Discovers and selects local Skills for a task
Decomposes tasks into ordered work units and groups
Orchestrates task execution and checks deliverables
